proposals.title: Close TASK-0006 review-03: capture Number constants and supply compile+boundary evidence
proposals.why_now: TASK-0006 has been rejected through three successive reviews. Exactly two MAJOR findings remain from review-03: (1) canonical.ts reads Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and Number.NaN from the live global at call time inside capturedParseInt10, violating the no-user-code-execution and captured-intrinsics guarantees of ADR-009; (2) the validation evidence supplies no independently captured output for npm run compile or npm run boundary on the corrected candidate. Both fixes are mechanical and narrowly scoped. CanonicalEncoder acceptance is a hard prerequisite for StateHash, which in turn gates INV-01, INV-22, and the FASE-1 CI replay gate. Every FASE-1 hash-dependent deliverable remains blocked until this task is accepted.

proposals.title: Implement positional RNG per ADR-002 and file ADR for hash function selection
proposals.why_now: ADR-002 mandates a positional, O(1), seed-deterministic rand(masterSeed, namespace, ...coordinates) function with no PRNG state. All 10 registered namespaces (market.trend, market.factor, market.regime, macro.schedule, macro.payload, bot.policy, bot.decision, npc.tip.truth, npc.tip.payload, quest.roll, venue.liquidity) must be enumerated. The hash function is DEFINIR; proceeding requires an ADR resolving it (SplitMix64 over FNV-1a is the documented recommendation). RNG is required before any price generation, macro events, or bot decisions can be implemented. Filing the ADR first keeps the resolution auditable and avoids a SPEC_BLOCKERS entry.

proposals.title: Implement multi-commodity double-entry ledger foundation in @ciclo/domain
proposals.why_now: The ledger is a FASE-1 deliverable (§15) and a prerequisite for market orders, the tick loop, and the rounding-residue account (ADR-004). Accounts, Entry, Transaction, and balance-per-commodity queries are enumerated and locked in §6 and §4. The implementation is dependency-ready once numeric types are stable and is entirely within @ciclo/domain with no dependency on world, narrative, or RNG. Doing this now allows the tick loop and market order work to proceed in parallel with price generation.
